prOriginal.nota: Benchmark head ea188e2d736f is the master merge commit of #93989 (merged 2025-06-20). Base 49a275847631 is the merge of #93864 'feat(replays): Add self-serve bulk deletes' (the benchmark title). The diff spans 32 master commits merged 2025-06-20; TPs come from #93917 (#01,#02), #93669 (#06,#07,sncc-01,opa-01), #93902 (#12,#13), #93739 (#19), #93964 (opa-02), #93989 (opa-03), all merged 2025-06-20, so the reference date is 2025-06-20. Code is identical to master at that commit.

replays-self-serve-bulk-delete-system-se.reason: validate_timestamp/validate_age kept the truthiness checks self.initial_data.get('age'/'timestamp') through every later edit (#93999, #94325, #94414, #95036). PR #104223 deleted browser_reporting_collector.py and its route as part of an endpoint cleanup; no equivalent code exists on master.

The validation-failure logger.warning still carried extra={'validation_errors': ..., 'raw_report': report} in the last version (after #95036). The whole endpoint was removed by #104223 (cleanup, not targeting logging).

fetch_error_details moved to src/sentry/replays/usecases/summarize.py (#96278) and still pairs `zip(error_ids, events.values())`. nodestore get_multi (now src/sentry/services/nodestore/base.py) still builds uncached items then items.update(cache_items) and omits missing nodes, so order/length can still diverge from error_ids.

The endpoint kept running query_replay_instance before checking enable_error_context up to its 2025-07-30 version. #97008 deleted the experimental endpoint; today's rpc_get_replay_summary_logs has no enable_error_context opt-out at all, so the behaviour is gone.

#94034 'use new table widget in dashboards' replaced columns={[]} and the empty tableData with columns built by decodeColumnOrder from the widget fields and tableData=convertTableDataToTabularData(tableResults[0]), so the table now renders the real results.

#94425 deleted defaultTableCellRenderers.tsx and replaced renderTableBodyCell/renderTableHeadCell (with `if (cell)` fallback) by a getRenderer/makeBaggage API whose renderer output is rendered directly. The truthiness-fallback logic no longer exists; the change redesigned the API rather than targeting the falsy case.

The key ['use-trace-item-attribute-keys', queryOptions(, search)] stayed org-less through every revision until 2026-04-15. #113047 replaced the hook with traceItemAttributeKeysOptions built on apiOptions, whose queryKey is [url, options] with url containing organization.slug; its description cites making cache key behaviour consistent.

astra.pergunta: #113047 removed the hook and moved to apiOptions, whose key is the URL with the org slug; PR says it makes cache key behavior consistent. confirmado or descontinuado?
astra.resposta: #113047 kept the functionality and put the org slug in the query key via the URL, ending the cross-org collision; any way of fixing counts.

replays-self-serve-bulk-delete-system-se.reason: #94126 'error context timestamps should be in MS' changed fetch_error_details to timestamp=data.get('timestamp', 0.0) * 1000. Today summarize.py still multiplies by 1000 before interleaving with recording timestamps.

The paginated endpoint fetched all errors before self.paginate on every page until #97008 removed it. Today summaries go through rpc_get_replay_summary_logs, called once per summary without pagination (trace errors limit=100; direct errors still uncapped but fetched once).

astra.pergunta: Paginated endpoint removed in #97008; today's Seer RPC fetches direct errors once per summary, still uncapped. descontinuado or pendente?
astra.resposta: Removing the endpoint eliminated the per-page re-fetch of all errors; the uncapped direct fetch in the RPC is a residual risk but runs once per summary, not per page.

replays-self-serve-bulk-delete-system-se.reason: #94100 'Hiding some attrs from tree' passed hiddenAttributes={HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES} to AttributesTree, which filters those names regardless of search, so they are hidden in the default (no-search) view too. Later #97416 deliberately removed internal-attribute filtering, a separate product decision.

The cited test (test_run_bulk_replay_delete_job_completion) still mocks delete_matched_rows. #121644 added test_delete_matched_rows_archives_in_the_replays_own_range, which calls the real delete_matched_rows with max_segment_id None (only publish_replay_event patched), so removing the guard in _make_recording_filenames would raise TypeError and fail it; gap closed incidentally.

astra.pergunta: Test added in #121644 calls real delete_matched_rows with max_segment_id None; the cited test still mocks. confirmado or pendente?
astra.resposta: The #121644 test reaches the guard; removing it raises TypeError and fails that test, so the gap closed incidentally even though the cited test is unchanged.
